notes: The em-dash-laden self-interruption, the footnote-style qualifications embedded mid-sentence, and the move from abstraction to hyper-specific concrete detail (fluorescent purgatory of an airport gate) are all unmistakably DFW, though the voice skews more toward his essays than his fiction and the self-referential meta-commentary on the newsletter format, while clever, may alienate readers expecting a conventional industry roundup.
